blurb: A heavy armoured truck for seven: a driver, a front passenger and two on the bench behind them, a rear machine gunner on the roof and two riders hanging on its sides, all but the driver and gunner shooting their own weapons

notes.model: Dust Runner (Meshy Community, CC0; content/guns.json vehicles/dust_runner.glb, 2026-11-10): a closed two-door off-roader with a roof rack, 5.3 m long, 2.56 m wide and 2.57 m tall, fitted to the box. It rides on the owner's Rugged Off-Road Tire (vehicles/offroad_tire.glb), one at each hub (2026-11-12): the body's own tires, which were part of its one mesh and never turned, are cut out of it and dropped (guns.json `parts`, `drop`). Hubs and size measured on them: 0.53 m radius, 0.42 m wide, hubs 0.53 m up at x ±1.04, z 1.675 and -1.3; the body's lowest point left is 0.373 m up (`rideHeight`). The Car Kit delivery truck it replaced is the fallback (vehicles/armored_rover.glb).
notes.seats: Measured on the model: the cab floor 0.7 m up from z 0.4 back to the tailgate, the windscreen at z 0.6-0.9, the roof and its rack 2.4-2.5 m up from z 0.6 to -2.2. The driver moves back from the old truck's cab (z 1.5, now the hood) to the front seat (z 0.05); the gunners stand on the rack at its front and back ends. Roles, weapons and arcs unchanged. The three inside sit (2026-11-11: standing on the floor their heads came out through the roof, 2.5 m): cushions 1.02 m up, the driver on the left front seat, the two passengers on a bench against the panel behind the front seats (the in-house cockpit draws the seats and the bench, client content/cockpits.ts). Owner, 2026-11-13: seven places: the driver and a front passenger (the right front seat, the driver's mirrored), the two on the bench behind, the rear gunner (the front gun is gone) and two hanging on the outside, one each side, standing on the sill beside the doors (x ±1.18, just outside the door panels at ±1.06, z 0.2 between the door pillars at z 0.98 and -0.55, feet 0.8 m up) facing out. Owner, 2026-11-13 (the rear gunner stood high on the rack): he stands inside at the rear gun like a hatch gunner (feet 1.35 m up, his shoulders out of the roof at 2.4-2.5 m, as the Gun Buggy's gunner), not on the rack; arc and facing unchanged.
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height in the driver's seat, under the roof, behind the windscreen.
notes.vehicle: Speeds, turn, grip and mass unchanged. Suspension added 2026-11-12 so its tires steer and ride springs (a vehicle without it only rolls them): the Troop Truck's stiff truck springs (which were derived from this vehicle), on this body's four hubs. On level ground it drives as before; with a wheel off the ground (a crest, a kerb) it now grips less, as every sprung vehicle does.
